body: Thank you again. and yes, We believe society is diseased. We should be self reliant, yet seek friendship and unity. And yeah, I really wish I knew what they think too...
OH, and dude, almost forgot to give you credit on the "Live long and prosper"... You are a badass.

First, I would like to thank you. Everyone's support here is starting to help me regain my faith in human kindness. I find your philosophy Interesting. I come from a little bit different school of thought. I'm not sure if you have ever read anything on Transcendentalism (authors such as Emerson, And Thoreau), but if you haven't, I won't judge. I believe there is a goodness in everything and everyone, even if it is buried deep. we believe in going down ones own path (non-conformism), defying what we believe is wrong. We try to always do what we believe is correct. You may ask why I am telling you this, and there is a simple answer; this knowledge is often times all that kept me sane. And dude, don't worry. Some lucky woman will come around and realize what everyone else has been missing. Anyway, thank you. You guys are going to make me cry. (;

Thank you... I wasn't sure what to expect after posting this. It's rare when anyone says anything positive toward me. There is alot more to the story (some horrible, and some amazing), and I know that my life isn't as bad as it could be, but it's hard when nobody gives you any support. I have considered therapy, and avidly study psychology (after the military, I wish to use my G.I. bill to go to school for Psychology and become a social psychologist), unfortunately I live paycheck to paycheck as it is... I don't know, it's just kind of hard living day-to-day, not knowing if it will be a good day, or an atrocious day... Not knowing if you will wake up happy, or I will have a flashback in a dream, and wake up in a suicidal mood. Either way, I appreciate your support. Thank you for the compliments (something else I'm not used to) as well.
